name.en: Dorfiella knowltonii water fern (historically Hydropteris pinnata)
name.zh: Dorfiella knowltonii 羽叶水蕨（旧称 Hydropteris pinnata）

description.en: Original stylized-inspired static water-fern art, using Dorfiella knowltonii following Hermsen (2025); Hydropteris pinnata is the historical 1994 name. Round junction structures are an artistic interpretation of uncertain, possibly sporocarp-like appendages, not confirmed reproductive organs. Colors, pose and nominal dimensions are artistic.
